title: Onboarding redesign
text:
Author: **Priya Raman** · Status: Approved · Reviewers: Maya, Sam, Wop
## Why we changed it
The old onboarding had 7 screens. In the Westbrook beta, 4 of the 12 students Tomas interviewed almost quit on the "about you" screen. Our goal is that a new student can join their first group in **under 2 minutes**.
## New flow (4 screens)
1. **Welcome** - a 10-second video of a study group in action
2. **University and courses** - search your university, then pick your courses and sections
3. **Free time** - a simple weekly grid. Tap to mark the hours you are free.
4. **Study style** - quiet, discussion, or exam cram. This screen also asks for the notification permission (needed for Android 15).
## What we removed
- The "about you" screen (major, year, hobbies, bio)
- The profile photo step. We now ask for a photo after the student's first group session.
## Open questions
- Should students be able to skip the free-time grid and fill it in later?
- Do we need a short tutorial after onboarding, or is the first group invite enough?
## Feedback
- Maya: Love the shorter flow. Make sure the video loads fast on slow campus Wi-Fi.
- Sam: The permission request on screen 4 fixes the Android 15 notification bug.
- Wop: Please add a progress bar (1 of 4, 2 of 4...).
